newsitem.title: PERU: Peru says April tax revenues up 7.6 percent.
newsitem.headline: Peru says April tax revenues up 7.6 percent.

text.p: Peru's tax revenues in April were 2.321 billion soles, 7.6 percent higher in real terms than the same month last year, the National Superintendency of Tax Administration (SUNAT) said Tuesday.
Tax revenues for the first four months of the year were 7.727 billion soles, up 3.5 percent in real terms from the same period last year, SUNAT added in its monthly report.
Tax revenues rose 4.9 percent in real terms during 1996 to 19.94 billion soles.
